title: Bringing a Payoff Figure to the Closing Date for Home Purchase Financing Sale Paydowns
content:
**Closing coordination note — the payoff measure for a Home Purchase Financing loan on a home under contract in an In-Place Home Resale file**

The payoff statement issued on the paydown date may be good through a date that does not match the sale's closing date, which is the closing date on the In-Place Home Resale file under contract. The payoff measure is then brought to the closing date with the daily payoff interest.

**Daily payoff interest.** The daily payoff interest is the unpaid principal times the note rate divided by 100, divided by 365, rounded half up to the cent.

**Rule.** Where that statement is good through a date more than 3 days after the closing date, the payoff measure is its payoff amount less the daily payoff interest for each day after the closing date through the good-through date; where it is good through a date before the closing date, the payoff measure is its payoff amount plus the daily payoff interest for each day after the good-through date through the closing date. Where the statement is good through the closing date or no more than 3 days after it, its payoff amount is not adjusted.

### Cases (hypothetical: unpaid principal 58000.00, note rate 9.24 percent, statement good through 2026-06-01)

The daily payoff interest is 58000.00 times 9.24 divided by 100, divided by 365, that is 14.68274…, rounded to 14.68.

| Closing date | Good-through date relative to closing | Adjustment to the statement's payoff amount |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-26 | 6 days after | less 14.68 for each of 6 days, that is less 88.08 |
| 2026-05-29 | 3 days after | none |
| 2026-06-01 | the closing date itself | none |
| 2026-06-05 | 4 days before | plus 14.68 for each of 4 days, that is plus 58.72 |
